findings.classification: independent executed synthetic validator mutations; no candidate claim
findings.observed: The validator accepts exact text with live_layer_apply(vars) only inside if False and accepts pre_actions on a conversation node, although official docs say the engine drops that field.
findings.remedy: Require a code/api_request node and a reachable dispatch with an unconditional unshadowed apply(vars) before current raw consumption. Replay a sentinel through every actual dispatch branch. Check the recipient result is actually used with the current raw/name arguments; AST presence alone cannot prove order or execution.

findings.observed: Security phases outside recipient/dob/phone retain raw 2718 in live_observed_prior even with verified=False. Conversely a JSON-serialized financial state defaults to recipient and suppresses the layer entirely. No bank authority or consent mutation observed.
findings.remedy: Define a typed stable broker input contract using a receipt-derived verified flag and an explicit semantic-phase allowlist. Security mode must return before history capture for every identity question. Normalize state representation deliberately and never infer permission from a phase name. Current-only export needs no raw history; avoid persisting copied security operands.

findings.classification: independent neutral source CPU; SELF advances eligibility only, never bank identity
findings.observed: Yes. Riley is not me. and Yes. I am Riley Vale’s cousin. return SELF from the first affirmative; later denials/relations are UNKNOWN and do not veto it. Role-play/pretending suffixes likewise leave an earlier SELF decisive.
findings.remedy: Resolve explicit subject, contradiction, attribution and hypothetical qualifiers across the whole current turn before accepting any affirmative. A relation or non-self correction that is not fully parsed must block SELF, while an independent security-answer refusal must not erase valid recipient identification. Preserve bare yes and exact names in unqualified opening replies.

findings.observed: Yes, this is Riley Vale speaking. returns UNKNOWN. Bare given name, title+surname, inverted names and tested accented/apostrophe forms pass.
findings.remedy: Parse a self prefix and conventional speaking suffix together before comparing the complete supplied name. Keep different-given-name, contradictory subject, quoted and hypothetical controls. Do not broadly strip unmatched titles or accept arbitrary same-surname mentions.

findings.source: competition/live_layer.py:prepare; current pure runtime and current_only_run bundle
findings.classification: executed compatibility checks; model still being regenerated
findings.observed: Pinned older model d3af3e7d lacks logit_cutoffs and quant_logit_margins and is INVALID under current runtime a060566f. The actual bundled older runtime/model pair is valid. Therefore a dead deployed student is NOT established. prepare accepts a correctly hashed but invalid synthetic model without testing the runtime pair.
findings.remedy: Freeze the completed new manifest/model/runtime together; validate the exact embedded pair before generation with a neutral nonempty input, check disabled authorization heads and UNKNOWN authority. Report inactive heads honestly. A new manifest must not silently pair an old model with newer runtime.

findings.classification: latest trainer source inspection only; no fit/data/outcome audit
findings.observed: Trainer changed during native inference. Latest inspected code uses independent student CAL-fit cutoffs, separate group CAL-risk, current-only feature projection and a 16*scale analytic margin for two L2-normalized 256-bin blocks. Small empirical .95 precision with >=10 selections is diagnostic, not qualification. Current pure runtime rejects malformed numeric/model inputs but allows any finite nonnegative margin.
findings.remedy: Bind exact runtime/feature version, thresholds and analytic margins in the final manifest. Require the margin bound for the declared context projection at preparation. Keep risk holdout out of tuning and preserve diagnostic/no-bank-authority status; quantization parity does not establish semantic precision.
